content.text:
Built the playable game in `index.html`. It includes a ray-cast FPS arena, five enemies, health and extraction objectives, and the one-round mechanic: fire once, then retrieve the round before you can shoot again.

Controls: **WASD** to move, **mouse** to aim, **click** to fire, **E** to retrieve. Touch controls are included for mobile. I also checked the start screen and gameplay screenshots.
